### Without Faith
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/without-faith
Passage: Hebrews 11:6
Points:
- True faith goes beyond outward profession and is evidenced by endurance without shrinking back from Christ.
- Pleasing God is possible only through genuine faith, which justifies believers and restores their relationship with Him.
- Coming rightly to God requires believing both that He exists and that He rewards those who seek Him.
- Biblical faith is an active gift from God that diligently pursues fellowship through prayer, worship, and Scripture.

### The Duty of Living in the Reality of the Supernatural
Author: Alex Crain
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-duty-of-living-in-the-reality-of-the-supernatural-crosswalk-the-devotional-july-5-2011.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:6
Points:
- True Christian spirituality requires living daily in the experiential reality of God, not merely holding correct doctrine.
- The prevailing naturalistic worldview constantly threatens to dull a believer's awareness of God's presence.
- Scripture illustrates that God's unseen, supernatural work is active and near, even when physically invisible.
- Believers must actively exercise faith to overcome worldly skepticism and draw near to the living God.
